The '''Sound Sealed Star''', added in [[Update_Log#Update_6_-_Jujutsu_Kaisen_Update_Part_1|Update 6]], is a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the [[Infinity Castle]] (1st Season). This item has become '''unobtainable''' as of Update 7.

* <span style="color:#FFC208;">+Required to obtain a special unit...</span>

* <span style="color:#fc4242;">This Star is sealed with a powerful magic and cannot be opened yet...</span> (Prior to Update 7)
